items.item_text: resume

Manage a portfolio of individual donors and prospects, developing and implementing cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, and engagement strategies that advance philanthropic support and strengthen long-term relationships.
Conduct donor outreach through calls, meetings, written correspondence, briefings, and other engagement activities to deepen relationships and move donors through the development cycle.
Partner with frontline fundraisers, development colleagues, and UC ANR leadership to coordinate donor strategy, support solicitations, and help advance complex donor opportunities.
Research donor backgrounds, philanthropic interests, and engagement history to identify opportunities for cultivation, solicitation, and future support.
Develop and coordinate donor-facing materials, including proposals, briefings, acknowledgments, reports, presentations, and other communications that support fundraising and donor engagement.
Create and implement individualized donor communication and engagement strategies that reflect donor interests, program priorities, and UC ANR’s mission.
Support the development of cases for support, fundraising briefs, and tailored approaches to engaging individual, corporate, and foundation donors.
Assist with donor events, briefings, recognition activities, and other development-related programs that enhance relationships with UC ANR supporters.

Serve as a collaborative partner to the advancement team by sharing information, coordinating follow-up, supporting strategic initiatives, and contributing to integrated fundraising efforts across Development Services.
Provide informed recommendations on donor strategy, stewardship opportunities, and relationship management approaches based on donor interests, engagement history, and organizational priorities.
Serve as a resource to internal partners on donor relations, stewardship communications, and fundraising practices related to assigned projects and portfolios.
Comply with UC Development policies and related university guidelines.
Assist with annual reporting and gift acknowledgment activities to help ensure they are completed on time and remain aligned with donor intent and institutional standards.
Help ensure gifts are administered and utilized in accordance with donor intent, university policy, and applicable procedures; identify, resolve, or escalate discrepancies as needed.
Work with program staff, academics, volunteers, and other beneficiaries to collect gift use information and prepare concise, donor-centered stewardship materials.

Use donor databases and CRM systems, including Raisers Edge NXT or similar platforms, to maintain records, document donor interactions, support fundraising strategy, and strengthen stewardship activity.
Review and audit assigned records and portfolios to ensure donor, fund, and beneficiary information is accurate, complete, and useful for development planning.
Provide project coordination, operational support, and administrative follow-through for donor relations and Development Services projects.
Participate in planning for annual and longer-range donor relations and fundraising activities that support Development Services priorities and UC ANR strategic goals.
Contribute to the development and refinement of stewardship processes, donor communications, and internal practices that improve donor experience and program effectiveness.
